Today the Serra Pelada mine is abandoned and the giant open pit that was created by hand has filled with water, creating a small polluted lake.

It's more of an existential philosophical statement. To some, their purpose in life is hindered by worldly possessions. I personally feel tied to the things I own, so the less I own, the more free I feel. In a way, I feel obligated to them. It's very easy to get caught up in the shiny side of things, and lose track of the overall cost it takes to own them, and the life opportunities I miss when they distract me from the important things.
